title: Sigiriya & Dambulla Cave Temple
description: Ascend the iconic Lion Rock fortress and explore the ancient cave murals of Dambulla — a UNESCO double-whammy in one remarkable day.

title: Yala National Park Safari
description: Track leopards, elephants and hundreds of bird species through the grasslands and lagoons of Yala — Sri Lanka's most famous national park.

title: Kandy City & Temple of the Tooth
description: Discover Sri Lanka's cultural capital — the sacred Temple of the Tooth Relic, the beautiful Peradeniya Botanical Gardens, and a traditional Kandyan dance show.

title: Mirissa Whale Watching & Beach
description: Set sail at dawn to encounter blue whales and spinner dolphins in the Indian Ocean, then spend the afternoon on Mirissa's golden crescent beach.

title: Nuwara Eliya Tea Plantation Trail
description: Walk through rolling emerald tea estates, visit a working tea factory, and enjoy a world-class high tea with panoramic highland views.

title: Galle Fort Heritage Walk
description: Stroll the Dutch colonial ramparts of Galle Fort, browse its boutique galleries and cafes, and watch the sun set over the Indian Ocean from the lighthouse.
